svg.title: Figure 12 · Peaks-over-threshold models
svg.desc: Generalized Pareto survival curves use scale 1. ES extrapolation uses threshold 2, exceedance probability 5% and scale 0.8. Parameters are illustrative population inputs; no tail fit to market data is implied.
